fingerprint.details:
Read scratch/applyall/WORKER_BRIEF.md first, then implement OpenSpec change `reconcile-overnight-runs-after-restart` (openspec/changes/reconcile-overnight-runs-after-restart: proposal, design if present, specs/**, tasks.md). It builds on the now-archived changes enforce-overnight-cancellation-and-limits, admit-overnight-tasks-on-evidence (see crates/jcode-app-core/src/overnight.rs, overnight/admission_gate.rs, overnight/enforce.rs, crates/jcode-overnight-core/src/admission.rs), reattach-background-tasks-after-reload and make-worker-stop-durable. Reuse their contracts; do not invent parallel ones.

Env: `export PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH` first (rustup toolchains are gone; use system cargo; never run rustup). Run cargo via `JCODE_REMOTE_CARGO=0 scripts/dev_cargo.sh`. Tests with `--lib -- --test-threads=1 <filter>`. Workspace clippy is clean at HEAD, so any new diagnostic is yours. Format only with `rustfmt --edition 2024 <your files>`; never cargo fmt --all. Never touch src/cli/terminal.rs (another session's dirty file) or openspec/changes/adopt-upstream-v1-0-1. Task 1.3 (TUI Interrupted views) edits TUI files: keep surgical and check git diff for foreign hunks.

IMPORTANT: server reloads kill workers. Write scratch/applyall/fix-reconcile-overnight.md EARLY (skeleton first: status, files, tests) and update it as you go, and also write scratch/applyall/manifest-reconcile-overnight.txt listing every file you changed. Fail closed: restart reconciliation must never resume CancelRequested, never resume when authorization/budget cannot be verified, never duplicate a live owner. Include loop-level tests for each scenario in task 1.4. Leave 2.2 and 2.3 unchecked; the coordinator runs workspace clippy and validate. Do not commit or archive.
